# The Red Sparrow

> The Red Sparrow is an independent game development brand focused on Unity game development and interactive experiences.

## About
The Red Sparrow develops game experiences with Unity, combining gameplay systems, 3D asset integration, game interface design, and mobile-focused experiences.

## Services
- Unity game development: gameplay programming, mechanics, interactive systems, scene setup, and integration.
- 3D integration: models, characters, environments, animations, and visual assets in Unity projects.
- Game UI/UX: menus, HUDs, navigation flows, and in-game interface implementation.
- Mobile game development: mobile-oriented gameplay, interface adaptation, and build preparation for supported devices.
